content: On the Hour, Level Seven, the men of might and vision (Q 38:45), is peculiar to the present time. Ibn Turka says that, as 'our Sayyid' has made clear, what advanced thinkers and verifiers made known in general terms is the emergence of the meanings in the perfect form, but they could not deduce them in full detail nor construe the Day of Judgment, the Balance, the weighing of deeds and the Pool, all the sole preserve of the Amir ʿAlī, and they did not discover the method of extracting meaning from the letters without human effort. The details are to be construed by jafr, the method known to the servants of the House of the Prophet.
refers_to_primary: Ibn Turka, R. Shaqq-i Qamar u Bayān-i Sāʿat
